mapper.select: SELECT c.benefits_info AS benefitsInfo, COALESCE(cms.total_spending_amount, 0) AS previousMonthSpendingAmount FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id LEFT JOIN card_monthly_status cms ON cms.user_card_id = uc.user_card_id AND cms.target_year_month = #{previousYearMonth} WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId}
mapper.sql: p.payment_id, p.user_card_id, m.merchant_name, m.category_code, c.card_name, uc.pan_last4, p.payment_time, p.original_amount, p.discount_amount, p.final_amount, p.benefit_service_name, p.payment_status, p.payment_method
FROM payments p JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = p.merchant_id JOIN user_cards uc ON uc.user_card_id = p.user_card_id JOIN cards c ON c.card_id = uc.card_id
mapper.select: SELECT user_card_id, payment_token, token_expiry_date FROM user_cards WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND deleted_at IS NULL AND token_expiry_date >= CURDATE()
SELECT merchant_id FROM merchants ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1
